pool.text:
Consider the two functions \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \) and \( g(x) = dx + e \). The graph of \( f(x) \) is a parabola with its vertex at \((3, -1)\) and passes through the point \((1, 3)\). The graph of \( g(x) \) is a straight line passing through the points \((0, 2)\) and \((1, 3)\).

If the graphs of \( f(x) \) and \( g(x) \) intersect at two points and \( p < 3 \) is the integer \( x \)-coordinate of one of those intersection points, find the value of \( \dfrac{a+d}{p} \).
pool.educational_aim: Master AA/AI SL — Functions, Statistics & Analytical Calculus through multi-step analytical modeling.
pool.exam_archetype: AA/AI SL — Functions, Statistics & Analytical Calculus — Analytical Synthesis
pool.sol: Since \( f(x) \) has vertex \((3, -1)\), write \( f(x) = a(x - 3)^2 - 1 \). Using \( f(1) = 3 \): \( 3 = 4a - 1 \implies a = 1 \), so \( f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 8 \). For the line \( g(x) \) through \((0, 2)\) and \((1, 3)\), the slope is \( d = \dfrac{3 - 2}{1 - 0} = 1 \), giving \( g(x) = x + 2 \). Setting \( f(x) = g(x) \): \( x^2 - 6x + 8 = x + 2 \implies x^2 - 7x + 6 = (x - 1)(x - 6) = 0 \), so \( x = 1 \) or \( x = 6 \). Since \( p < 3 \), \( p = 1 \), and \[ \frac{a + d}{p} = \frac{1 + 1}{1} = 2. \] [M1] [A1]
hints: Write \( f(x) = a(x - 3)^2 - 1 \) using the vertex \((3, -1)\) and substitute \((1, 3)\) to find \( a = 1 \).
Find the slope \( d = 1 \) and equation \( g(x) = x + 2 \) from \((0, 2)\) and \((1, 3)\).
Solve \( x^2 - 6x + 8 = x + 2 \) to get \( x \in \{1, 6\} \), pick \( p = 1 < 3 \), and evaluate \( (a + d)/p = 2 \).
